## Summary

Adds the turn proposal for the Agent Behavior Trace Model, reviewed at the October 28 meeting, as `working-documents/AGENT-BEHAVIOR-TRACE-MODEL-TURN.md`, with its four figures under `working-documents/figures/`. It proposes how OpenTelemetry should define and record a turn, and the sequence of upstream proposals to the OpenTelemetry GenAI SIG.

The text is the version in the WG working document, converted to Markdown, with two changes:

- The taxonomy steps follow the Taxonomy & Landscape workstream's process: the terms go to its term sheet and its Monday vote first, and pull requests follow a KEEP vote.
- The terms proposed to the taxonomy are Turn, and Agent step with Step as an alias. Turn segment stays an OpenTelemetry term.

## Related Issue

Updates #43. Covers the October 28 action to bring the turn proposal into the repository ([minutes](https://github.com/aaif/wg-observability-and-traceability/blob/main/meeting-minutes/2026-10-28.md)).

## Review Notes

- Part 2 is the proposal. Appendix C has the design decisions and their tradeoffs.
- The link to the gaps update resolves once that pull request merges.
- The first upstream proposal is planned for the GenAI SIG meeting on November 3; comments here feed into it.

Suggested review window: 1 week. The upstream pull requests get their own review in the OpenTelemetry repository.

## Follow-ups

- Bring Turn and Agent step to the Taxonomy & Landscape workstream.
- Re-pin the OpenTelemetry revision the evidence is checked against, before the first upstream pull request.
- Open a request for contributions to a proof of concept and a mapping of current SDK implementations.
